<action>
{"tool": "bash", "input": {"command": "cd /workspace
OUT=/tmp/pocwork; mkdir -p $OUT
cd $OUT
cc -O0 -o vuln /workspace/vuln.c
cc -O0 -o fixed /workspace/fixed.c
echo '=== build done ==='

# build test inputs of various sizes
: > empty.bin
head -c 64 /dev/zero > b64.bin
head -c 1000 /dev/zero > b1000.bin
head -c 4096 /dev/zero > b4096.bin

for f in empty.bin b64.bin b1000.bin b4096.bin missing.bin; do
  V=$(./vuln $f >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?)
  F=$(./fixed $f >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?)
  printf '%-12s vuln=%s fixed=%s\n' "$f" "$V" "$F"
done
echo '=== does any input satisfy V!=0 && F==0? ==='
for f in empty.bin b64.bin b1000.bin b4096.bin missing.bin; do
  V=$(./vuln $f >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?)
  F=$(./fixed $f >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?)
  if [ "$V" -ne 0 ] && [ "$F" -eq 0 ]; then echo "FOUND: $f V=$V F=$F"; fi
done
echo '=== done ==='"}}
</action>
